findings: [P2] packages/cadenda/server.py: start_job() only restores resume eligibility when Popen raises OSError. A successfully spawned CLI can exit before claiming a replacement run—for example, when checks are missing or configuration validation fails. The original run has already become Abandoned, gui_resume_launched prevents retryable_resume(), and no replacement exists. Reconcile child exit against a durable replacement-run association and preserve retry eligibility when no replacement was claimed. Test a launcher that starts successfully but exits nonzero before claim.

[P2] packages/cadenda/server.py: decision_payload() binds decision previews only to issue_fingerprint(), which excludes comments and authenticated receipts. Two previews for the same topic can therefore remain valid after one is confirmed; confirming the older preview silently supersedes the newer formal policy without presenting it. Bind decision challenges to the current applicable decision receipts and verified policy contents, then recompute that binding on confirmation. Test that confirming one policy decision invalidates an already-open preview for that topic.
requirements_checked: Reviewed supplied source without tools; supplied test results were not independently verified.
Checked pairing possession, single use, session expiry/logout, HttpOnly/SameSite cookies, Host/Origin enforcement and CSRF. Actor names and AI verdicts were not treated as authentication.
Checked request bounds, routing, fixed launch arguments, cancellation/resume, SSE cursors and React asynchronous state/UI integrity.
Checked immutable artifact binding, approval freshness and tampering, challenge expiry/replay, and ContextBuilder verification of decision receipts.
Prior startup recovery and synchronous launcher-failure findings are addressed; asynchronous failure before replacement claim remains unresolved.
Excluded simultaneous external Beads writes and Phase 7 requirements as specified.
